# Documents: Get Released Tax Documents

Area overview and notes: [documents.md](../documents.md)

`GET /accounts/{id}/tax-documents` · tenant-scoped token

Retrieve released tax documents associated with a given account using your system's unique identifier for the Account. Returns the latest of each tax document and year by default.

**Path parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `id` | Your system's unique identifier for the Account. |

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `include_historical` | boolean | No | Retrieves all revisions of a user's released tax forms, potentially returning multiple revision numbers for each form type and year. When not passed, only the latest released tax document for each type and year is included in the response. |
| `url_expiration_time` | string | No | Sets the URL expiration time in seconds. The default is 10 minutes. You can set the expiration time to a maximum of one hour. |

**Response 200**: Account tax documents

An array of objects with these fields:

| Field | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `[].created_date` | string (date-time) | No | ISO-8601 formatted date for the Tax Document creation timestamp. |
| `[].id` | string (uuid) | No | Taxbit's unique identifier for the Tax Document (UUID). |
| `[].revision` | number | No | Tax Document revision number. |
| `[].type` | string | No | Tax Document type. One of: `1042_S`, `1099_B`, `1099_C`, `1099_DA`, `1099_DIV`, `1099_INT`, `1099_K`, `1099_MISC`, `1099_NEC`, `1099_R`, `5498`, `CARF`, `CRS`, `DAC7`, `GAIN_LOSS_SUMMARY`, `GAIN_LOSS_SUMMARY_PDF`, `RMD_STATEMENT`, `TRANSACTION_SUMMARY`, `TRANSACTION_SUMMARY_PDF`, `UK_GAIN_LOSS_SUMMARY`. |
| `[].revision_type` | string | No | Indicates the type of the revision, or tax document. One of: `CORRECTION`, `ORIGINAL`, `VOID`. |
| `[].url` | string | No | Tax Document download URL. |
| `[].year` | number | No | Tax Document year. |
| `[].is_filed` | boolean | No | Indicates if the tax document has been filed to the relevant tax authority (ex. IRS) or if the tax document's final deliverable has been created (ex. DAC7 XML). |

**Errors:** 400 Bad Request · 429 Too Many Requests
